text.p: These are the headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Teens escaped cult death ritual: Children say they talked their parents out of including them in Solar Temple suicide pact.
- Red Cross switches gears with firing: Charity prepared to make changes.
- Ontario to alter school funding: Source puts cut at C$1.5 billion.
- Major's wife hopes for dignity in defeat: 'One is hustled out rather ignominiously,' she says of Downing Street.
- Dark days ahead in youth job market: Statscan report draws gloomy picture of long-term employment prospects for those in teens, early 20s.
- Caisse pushes mega-merger: Quebec pension fund pressuring Avenor to hold off on Repap deal, consider 3-way alliance with Domtar.
- TrizecHahn stocks war chest with share issue: Takes stake in L.A. real estate deal.
- Greenline targets Australia: TD's discount broker makes bid for Pont Securities.
- Credibility an issue in B.C. budget: Fiscal promises will get close scrutiny.
- Domtar pushes to join Avenor-Repap: Move throws into doubt tomorrow's vote on share exchange.
- Bass share foray may herald MacBlo shakeup.
